text:
sam: FYI - deploy today included the v1->v2 name change: `model` -> `model_id`. we spotted scattered examples in non-js clients (ruby/go) during canary. need a short coordinated fix.

hana: noted. which repos? docs only or also example apps and language SDKs?

sam: docs, examples, and the `examples-ruby` repo. QA flagged an integration test in examples-ruby that started failing after canary.

priya: can we do an automated codemod for fenced code blocks? i can write a simple sed/regex but worry about prose and JSON snippets.

ben: codemod is fine for code blocks. for inline prose we should add a lint rule to the docs-linter to warn on `\bmodel:\b` in code-fence languages. i've got a draft linter rule.

hana: also need to update redirects map so old deep links to snippets remain valid. i can add entries in `scripts/redirects.json`.

docs-bot: opened issue #489 in docs repo: "param rename: model -> model_id - sweep + redirects"

priya: plan proposal: 1) codemod to replace `model:` -> `model_id:` in fenced code blocks for js/py/rb/go. 2) PR to update prose in migration guide and quickstarts. 3) add docs-lint rule to catch remaining `model:` occurrences. 4) patch examples repos and run smoke tests.

sam: +1. add responsibility owners per step. priya owns codemod + initial PR, ben owns linter, hana owns redirects + examples-ruby update, and i'll own release note + status banner.

ben: codemod note - watch for `model` used as variable (e.g., `const model = ...`) and JSON objects named `model`. regex needs to be language-aware. i'll add a dry-run check in CI.

priya: using jscodeshift for JS, lib2to3-style tool for py, and a quick ruby parser for rb. will run against `examples/` and `docs/` and produce a patchset.

ci-bot: lint job queued for branch `param-codemod-sweep`

priya: example codemod snippet: ```bash
# jscodeshift example
jscodeshift -t codemods/replace-model-param.js docs/ examples/ --extensions=js,ts
```

hana: added redirects entries for three old snippet URLs to `redirects.json`. also synced with infra to ensure netlify rewrite works for staging.

ben: pushed docs-linter rule. i'll add an allowlist for prose mentions when clearly not param context.

priya: opened PR #498: codemod sweep for model->model_id (js/py/rb/go). included changelog entry pointing to migration guide. tagged reviewers @ben @hana @sam.

ci-bot: PR #498 - checks: codemod-dryrun (pass), lint (warn), smoke (fail) - failing in `examples-ruby/integration_test.rb`.

sam: what's failing in ruby tests? paste trace?

hana: trace: `ArgumentError: unknown keyword: model` at examples-ruby/test_client.rb:42. snippet shows: `client.generate(model: 'rwd-1-small', prompt: 'hi')`

priya: patching ruby example in PR now. also adding a small note in migration guide about keyword args in ruby requiring rename.

ben: reran lint after ruby fix, warnings down to 2 (those are prose instances in translated docs). locale teams need heads-up.

hana: contacted localization: they will run find/replace in i18n branches after we merge. estimated 6 hours for translations.

sam: deployment plan: merge docs PR to staging, run full smoke suite (notebooks + examples), then deploy a docs banner and send small customer blurb. if anything critical we roll-back docs only. server change is permanent so we can't revert runtime.

priya: CI now green on PR #498. ready to merge after reviews.

hana: reviewed and approved. added commit updating `redirects.json`.

ben: approved. merged PR.

docs-bot: staging deploy started for branch `param-codemod-sweep` - https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/params/model-id-migration

ci-bot: smoke tests running (notebooks, quickstarts, examples-ruby, examples-go).

ci-bot: smoke tests passed except `notebooks/advanced-chat.ipynb` which still referenced `model` inside a markdown code snippet used by tutorial runner.

sam: patch that notebook in-place. also add tutorial-runner check to CI to fail if notebooks contain flagged params in code cells.

priya: patched notebook and added tutorial-runner guard; opened small follow-up PR #501.

ci-bot: PR #501 CI green. merged. staging redeploy succeeded.

hana: localization queue updated and i18n teams notified.

sam: status page blurb drafted: "We rolled out a param rename (model -> model_id) in the API. SDKs include a compatibility shim. Migrate snippets by 2026-05-15. See migration guide: /migration/model-id." please review tone.

hana: tone looks good. suggest adding `compat shim` link to SDK changelog.

sam: added link. pushing final blurb and the in-console banner.

docs-bot: banner scheduled for 30m.

priya: retro item - add a PR-template checkbox: "Docs impact? run param-scan" and add an automated pre-merge GitHub Action `docs-sanity-check` that runs a quick grep against changed files. i'll open a follow-up PR.

ben: created GH action `docs-sanity-check` in infra repo and linked it to protected branches.

sam: excellent. post-mortem later but this is wrapped for now. thanks team. :clap:
